_what: The DECLARED TARGET of every row in vocabulary_formats.tsv, as data the harness reads.
_why: Rule 1 scopes rule 2: a false negative is judged against the row's OWN target, never the whole vocabulary. Until 2026-08-13 each row's target and its deliberate exclusions lived only as prose in the notes column, so nothing re-ran. checks/false_negatives.py reads this file; checks/lint.py checks that every row has exactly one entry here and no entry is an orphan.
_how_a_target_is_evaluated: 1. pull DISTINCT concept_code for concept_vocabulary_ids (+ concept_classes, + valid_only) from the named source
2. drop the exclusions (matched against the ORIGINAL concept_code, before any transform)
3. keep only codes fullmatching code_filter.pattern, if one is declared
4. apply transform, if one is declared
5. every surviving code MUST fullmatch \A(?:regexp)\z -- anything left over is an in-target false negative and fails the run
_editing: Adding a row to vocabulary_formats.tsv means adding its target here; lint fails otherwise. A new exclusion needs a 'why' naming the concept_id / invalid_reason / class that makes it not-a-code -- an exclusion without evidence is just a regexp that lost an argument.

athena.what: Stock OHDSI CONCEPT table as downloaded from Athena, tab-delimited. Covers every vocabulary OHDSI ships.

oi.what: vocabulation's build: the same Athena release with our supplemental vocabularies grafted on. The ONLY substrate that carries the OI-minted vocabularies (CPT4_HCPCS, ICD03_Morphology, ICD03_Topography) -- they are not in Athena, so rows targeting them cannot be scored against the CSV.

code_filter.why: CLAIMS DEFAULT (vfm-k2n): this row targets the 11-digit billing form only, so the 9-digit labeler+product codes are OUT of target and their non-match is correct, not a false negative. The 25 alphanumeric 11-character codes are NDC.ALPHANUM's target.
The FULL vocabulary, both the 9- and 11-digit forms -- but numeric only. The 39 alphanumeric concept_codes are NDC.ALPHANUM's target (see vfm-8l5).

targets.class_note: No filter: every NDC concept_code, alphanumeric forms included. This is the widest of the three NDC rows and the only one with no in-target exclusions.
